name: Adventure Ticket
description: Adventure time, grab your ticket!
longDescription: This ticket is used as an entry fee when you start the adventure command.

name: Bean Seeds
description: If beans make you fart, does the thing that makes beans make you fart too? Someone test this!
longDescription: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.

name: Box of Sand
description: How many of you pee'd in the sandbox as children? Well this item takes from that exact sandbox.
longDescription: Throw a box of sand in someone's eyes to prevent them from robbing anyone for 30 minutes. There is a small chance the sand will blow back in your own face and give you the negative effects.

name: Broccoli Seeds
description: Place them somewhere dark and damp and watch them grow to be edible. You just ate damp and old seeds.
longDescription: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.

name: Camera
description: Can be used to stream both on Twitch AND onlyfans!
longDescription: This item helps you with the amount of viewers watching your streams.

name: Candy Cane
description: I get that it is candy, but how is it a cane? It is way too small to use to walk.
longDescription: Using this item gives nothing of value.

name: Carrot Seeds
description: Plant these to grow cucumbers that are orange and help you see in the dark.
longDescription: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.

name: Cell Phone
description: Back in my day these flipped open and shut. Wait they brought that back?
longDescription: Use your cell phone to text your friends via the notifications system, or ring the police in the case of a bankrobbery. Misusing it (such as dialing police when there's no trouble) may cost you money.

name: Coin Bomb
description: This is not safe to take on planes. Not because it's a weapon, but because the pilots would leave the cockpit to partake.
longDescription: Using this item starts a coinbomb giveaway where users can join and earn a few thousand coins.

name: Corn Seeds
description: Corn cobs? Rare? Let's make an entire feature around growing more.
longDescription: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.

name: Duct Tape
description: It is not suspicious to buy this from the store UNLESS you buy it in bulk and wear a dark hoodie.
longDescription: This item can be used to craft things with the craft command.

name: Empowered Fart Bottle
description: This is like a fart bottle but like, without the downsides. Crazy item design right?
longDescription: Use this item to throw at a user to prevent them from running commands for a while, you cannot fail.

name: Fake ID
description: McLovin would be proud of the quality of this expensive and very real ID.
longDescription: Using this item hides you from the robbers wishlist and gives you a random fake name on leaderboards.

name: Fertilizer Bag
description: "Fertilize me", now without Ammonium nitrate because that's not good
longDescription: This tool can be used with the farm command to fertilize crops and shorten the time needed for plants to grow. Crops can be fertilized multiple times.

name: Fishing Pole
description: It's no Bassmaster 2000 but it should do the job.
longDescription: This item is required to access the fish command.

name: Green Screen
description: Hide the mess behind you so people don't know you're in shambles.
longDescription: This item increases your revenue from streaming.

name: Headphones
description: Open back is the best quality you'll find in headphones.
longDescription: This item increases your max idle time.

name: Hoe
description: Ain't nobody getting between me and my bros, bros before uh... nevermind.
longDescription: This tool can be used with the farm command to till dirt before planting or to clean up after a harvest.

name: Hunting Rifle
description: Bambi is VERY upset with you. Put it down!
longDescription: This item is required to access the hunt command.

name: Keyboard
description: Why are they called keys? Do they unlock the ability to type?
longDescription: This item is required to access the stream command.

name: Landmine
description: Who would have thought a game with pets would also involve landmines.
longDescription: Once active, if someone tries to steal from you, there's a 50% chance they will die from blowing up. Lasts 24 hours.

name: Microphone
description: Honestly the most important aspect of a streamer's toolkit.
longDescription: This item helps keep your stream online for longer by lowering the chance for it to randomly end while interacting.

name: Mouse
description: Why is it called a mouse?
longDescription: This item is required to access the stream command.

name: Padlock
description: The lock picking lawyer would make quick work of this I'm ngl to you.
longDescription: Use this padlock to lock your wallet from robbers. It is a one time use item. It can be broken when someone tries to steal from you as well.

name: Pet Food
description: Beggin strips taste like actual bacon and I will eat them regularly.
longDescription: This item can be used to feed your pets. If you have one in your inventory, feeding with the /pets care command will take this item instead of coins. Using this fills the entire hunger bar and gives much more XP.

name: Potato Seeds
description: Potato seeds are literally just... potatoes. What if we grew humans by planting humans. Wait, that is a zombie.
longDescription: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops. Try planting these in patterns with empty tilled and watered spaces nearby, and maybe you will discover a secret way to make new kinds of seeds appear and grow!

name: Ring Light
description: ElGato sells these, but you can make them yourself by taking an led panel and punching out the middle.
longDescription: This item lowers the minimum time between stream interactions.

name: Robbers Wishlist
description: Who would leave this laying around? It's such easy evidence against them...
longDescription: This item when used gives a list of users that aren't passive and do not have a fake ID on. Basically, anyone who is able to be robbed!

name: Rusty Machine
description: Pepe stole this rusty piece of junk from some abandoned farming museum and insists we let you use it. Don't ask us how it works.
longDescription: Using this item gives you a chance to convert your excess seeds into something better. Warning, the machine often malfunctions, and good results are not guaranteed.

name: Shovel
description: Hitting things with a shovel usually fixes it.
longDescription: This item is required to access the dig command.

name: Snowball
description: Snowballs are not scary until you freeze them. This one is frozen.
longDescription: Using this on a user will prevent them from doing negative actions to you for a few minutes.

name: Sound Card
description: Sound cards are kinda overrated irl.
longDescription: This item helps your odds of getting other streaming items.

name: Stonk Machine
description: This is a made up machine. It does not exist in real life. Do not search for this irl.
longDescription: Use this machine to try and earn some coins from stonk investment. Warning, there is a 10% chance to lose 10% of your wallet from a bad investment! Found from the day trader job.

name: Tip Jar
description: Why do they slide the tip jar at me "accidentally" every time as if I wasn't going to tip.
longDescription: Use this item to get some random rewards every hour. Found from the twitch streamer job.

name: Used Diaper
description: This is used, but seems like too much for a child. Who wore this?
longDescription: Throw this used diaper at someone to prevent them from joining or starting a heist for 12 hours. Found from the house wife job.

name: Voodoo Doll
description: I keep feeling a stabbing feeling in heart. Is it a heart attack or a voodoo doll? Probably just the doll.
longDescription: Using this on someone will give them bad luck in grind commands for 6 hours. Bad luck is like the opposite of the horseshoe but more potent.

name: Water Bucket
description: It is possible the dEvElOpEr that created this item plays the hit game Minecraft
longDescription: This tool can be used with the farm command to fill one tile completely with water, helping keep the surrounding tiles watered and cleaning the area after a harvest. When the water gets dirty it will no longer work and the space will have to dry before it can be used again.

name: Watering Can
description: Watering can? I sure can water with the watering can. Can I water the can first?
longDescription: This tool can be used with the farm command to water tilled tiles before planting.

name: Watermelon Seeds
description: Someone told me that if I eat these watermelon will grow in my stomach. Can confirm!
longDescription: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.
